Happy Valley, Oregon

Junk removal in Happy Valley

Happy Valley grew fast, and many of its homes are big, newer houses with three car garages and plenty of room to fill. It sits under nine road miles from our base, so it stays in the home zone. We work up the hills around Scouters Mountain, along Sunnyside Road, and in the subdivisions near Rock Creek.

Common Happy Valley jobs are leftover building materials after a remodel, old playsets the kids outgrew, and garages that have slowly filled since move in day. We take small amounts of drywall and lumber from a finished project, and we can haul a playset once it is taken apart.

Happy Valley questions

Good to know

Will you take apart a playset in Happy Valley?

We can take apart wooden playsets and swing sets for an added charge. If it is already in pieces, it is priced like any other load.

Can you get up a steep Happy Valley driveway?

Our truck handles most hillside driveways. If yours is very steep or narrow, send a photo of it with your items and we will plan the carry.

Is there a travel charge to Happy Valley?

No. Happy Valley is in our home zone, close to our base in Gresham, so there is no travel charge.

Which Happy Valley ZIP codes do you cover?

All of these: 97086. Type yours in the quote and the price includes travel.
